6848f8eabe11286f.description: About the Role Citi is seeking a Payments Operations Head to establish and lead the payments operations function for its new branch in Saudi Arabia. This full-time, senior management position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves building processing capabilities and infrastructure from the ground up. The objective is to ensure the seamless delivery of high-volume cash management and transaction services, making a direct impact on Citi's presence in the local market. Key Responsibilities Lead the establishment of Citi's Payments Operations function in Saudi Arabia, including building processing capability and infrastructure. Partner with Product and Technology teams to implement payment systems for the new branch's operations. Build and structure a local payments operations team, defining roles, workflows, and day-to-day governance. Oversee the governance of outsourced service providers handling branch transaction activity. Manage daily payments and cash transaction processing across multiple teams, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Resolve complex, high-impact operational issues within the branch. Evaluate team performance and guide decisions on training, development, and hiring to build local capability. Assess operational risk in daily decision-making, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and Citi internal policy. Manage client transaction reporting, including new product introductions, statement migrations, and legal disclaimers. Oversee quality reviews, end results, budget, policy formulation, and planning. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in payments operations or a related field. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team or department. Comprehensive understanding of concepts and procedures within payments operations. Experience in resolving highly complex and varying issues with substantial potential impact. Ability to negotiate internally at senior levels and with external parties as needed. Professional Conduct and Risk Management The Payments Operations Head is expected to appropriately assess risk when making business decisions, demonstrating particular consideration for Citi's reputation and safeguarding its clients and assets. This includes driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to policy, applying sound ethical judgment, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency. The role also involves effectively supervising the activity of others and fostering accountability. Work Environment and Benefits This role offers the opportunity to lead and shape a new payments operations function with full ownership from the outset. The position operates under a hybrid model, with three days in the office and two days working remotely each week. The successful candidate will collaborate with colleagues and teams across Citi's global network and have access to structured learning and development programs. Citi provides wellbeing resources and programs designed to support work-life balance, along with competitive compensation and support for long-term financial wellbeing.

68504e93dfff1e2d.description: About the Role Emdad By Elm is seeking a Market Inspector to join their team in Najran. This full-time role involves conducting field inspection tours and operations on markets and related establishments to ensure compliance with approved regulations, bylaws, and requirements. The inspector will be responsible for identifying and documenting violations, preparing necessary enforcement reports, and reviewing relevant permits and documents. Key Responsibilities Execute field inspection tours and visits to targeted markets and establishments. Verify adherence to relevant regulations, bylaws, and requirements. Monitor and document violations, and prepare enforcement reports in accordance with approved procedures. Inspect products, living organisms, and related materials within the scope of inspection. Review permits, documents, and records associated with inspection activities and verify their validity. Verify the authenticity of relevant international documents and permits, including CITES permits for endangered species. Prepare and submit inspection reports, documenting visit outcomes, observations, and violations to relevant authorities. Follow up on cases and observations that require completion of regulatory procedures. Directly interact with establishments, products, living organisms, and related documents and permits. Adhere to work plans, schedules, working hours, and assigned shifts. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Zoology, Veterinary Science, or a related discipline is required. A minimum of one year of relevant work experience. Prior experience in field inspection and supervision is preferred. Required Skills Ability to conduct field inspection tours and visits. Familiarity with relevant regulations, bylaws, and requirements. Proficiency in inspecting products, living organisms, and related materials. Capability to review documents and permits and verify their validity. Proficiency in English, particularly for reading and understanding international documents and permits such as CITES. Skill in preparing inspection reports and submitting observations to relevant authorities. Work Location This position is based in Najran, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply.

68572085321ddf37.description: About the Role SiFi is seeking a Customer Success Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for driving customer adoption, engagement, and retention across an assigned portfolio of business accounts. The specialist will focus on helping customers maximize the value of SiFi's usage by monitoring account activity, driving product and feature adoption, identifying engagement gaps, and proactively addressing potential churn risks. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview The Customer Success Specialist aims to strengthen customer relationships, improve retention, and drive sustainable growth in transaction volume (TPV). Working closely with the Customer Success Manager, the specialist will monitor account health, execute customer engagement initiatives, encourage product utilization, and translate customer usage data into actionable follow-up activities that improve customer satisfaction, platform adoption, and TPV growth. Primary Responsibilities Manage assigned customer accounts through proactive outreach, regular check-ins, and relationship building. Prioritize and manage multiple accounts, ensuring consistent engagement and timely follow-ups. Communicate relevant SiFi product and operational updates to customers with clear explanations and expectations. Drive adoption of SiFi's core features through product demonstrations, training, and proactive follow-ups. Identify adoption gaps and opportunities to increase adoption and transaction volume (TPV). Stay up to date with SiFi's features, functionality, and releases through regular internal communications and updates. Monitor account health, TPV, and engagement indicators to identify inactive and at-risk accounts. Take proactive recovery actions and escalate high-risk accounts to the Customer Success Manager. Document customer feedback, challenges, and feature requests. Identify recurring customer needs and proactively suggest product and feature enhancements. Coordinate with Product and Support to address customer needs and follow up on reported issues. Maintain complete and accurate CRM records of all customer interactions, meeting notes, call updates, and follow-up activities. Monitor portfolio performance through adoption, engagement, TPV, and retention metrics. Collaborate with internal teams on customer engagement campaigns and initiatives that drive adoption and retention. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is proactive, analytical, and customer-oriented. They should possess the ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritize activities, and identify opportunities to improve customer experience and product utilization. Experience and Work Type This role requires 0-1 years of relevant experience. It is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

68665d0fbb63d45a.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking an Inspector Arch/Hard Finishes to join the site-based construction supervision team. This full-time position is located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, specifically for a major public realm development in Diriyah (Heros Park). The objective of this program is to create a vibrant, inclusive environment that enhances livability, accessibility, and community well-being. Role Overview The Inspector Arch/Hard Finishes will be responsible for overseeing the quality and compliance of architectural and hard finishes works on site. This role involves daily monitoring of construction activities, ensuring adherence to approved drawings and specifications, and maintaining comprehensive records of inspections and progress. Key Responsibilities Attend and promptly address Inspection Requests (IRs) submitted by the contractor. Assist in reviewing submitted shop drawings against contract documents, local codes, statutory requirements, and international best practices. Report any works not in accordance with approved drawings and specifications to relevant stakeholders for action. Monitor the quality of executed works and daily site progress. Maintain daily activity records, including progress photos, ensuring they are available for inspection. Prepare surveillance reports for work deficiencies and Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) as required. Ensure effective coordination between discipline-related works and all other disciplines. Provide technical input to resolve discipline-related issues on-site. Inspect construction works to ensure compliance with approved methods and contract requirements. Maintain records of inspections and executed work. Assist in or measure work done when necessary. Observe site safety procedures. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to review construction documents and ensure compliance. Experience in public realm or large-scale development projects is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time, site-based position within the construction supervision team. The role requires regular presence on the project site in Diriyah, Riyadh, Ad Dir'iyah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

68a6a1eddd942832.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن فني أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، مع إمكانية العمل في الخرج. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة الطبية، بما يضمن الأداء الأمثل لهذه المعدات الحيوية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة مخططات تركيب الأجهزة الطبية المتنوعة مثل أجهزة غسل الكلى، وأجهزة دعم القلب والتنفس والرئة، وأجهزة التصوير والتخطيط الطبي. تحديد مواقع التركيب المناسبة ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب، بالإضافة إلى إعداد قوائم بقطع الغيار الاحتياطية الضرورية. الإشراف على إجراءات التشغيل التجريبي للأجهزة الطبية ومتابعة تشغيلها الفعلي وفقاً لأدلة التشغيل المعتمدة. تدريب مستخدمي الأجهزة الطبية على إجراءات التشغيل السليم والضبط الصحيح لضمان الاستخدام الفعال والآمن. تتبع مخططات الدارات الإلكترونية للأجهزة الطبية، وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس، وتنفيذ إجراءات الإصلاح والضبط اللازمة. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية بدقة، وذلك بحسب التعليمات الصادرة عن الشركة المصنعة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل الدورية المتعلقة بجميع المهام المنجزة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة وتركيب الأجهزة الطبية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الفنية والكهربائية للأجهزة الطبية. مهارات جيدة في استخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس لتشخيص الأعطال. القدرة على تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأجهزة الطبية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة. يقع مقر العمل الرئيسي في الرياض، مع إمكانية العمل في الخرج حسب الحاجة التشغيلية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة.

68d0b1accb6c3296.description: About Saudi Air Navigation Services Saudi Air Navigation Services (SANS) is dedicated to delivering safe and efficient Air Traffic Control services. As a key player in the aviation sector in Saudi Arabia, SANS focuses on maintaining high operational standards and continuous improvement in its systems and services. Role Overview SANS is seeking a CNS Systems Engineer to join its team. This full-time position is based in Saudi Arabia and is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The role involves participating in the deployment of communication, navigational aids, and surveillance (CNS) systems to ensure they meet the operational needs and requirements of SANS. Key Responsibilities Participate in the execution of CNS systems deployment projects. Ensure that deployed systems meet SANS's operational needs and requirements. Contribute to the delivery of Air Traffic Control services in a safe and efficient manner. Adhere to established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), agreed budgets, and adopted policies and procedures during system deployment. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated understanding of communication, navigational aids, and surveillance (CNS) systems. Ability to work within defined KPIs and budgetary constraints. Familiarity with operational policies and procedures. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Saudi Air Navigation Services, contributing to critical infrastructure that supports air traffic control. The role requires adherence to strict safety and efficiency standards. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications and are interested in contributing to the advancement of air navigation services are encouraged to apply.

6838e1d3526fcf21.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a highly skilled Mechanical Engineer to support a significant mega-development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves contributing to a landmark program that includes extensive utility infrastructure, irrigation networks, pumping stations, district cooling interfaces, water transmission systems, landscape infrastructure, public realm assets, and associated mechanical systems critical to the project's successful development and long-term operation. Role Context and Contribution The Mechanical Engineer will be a key member of the PMCM team, providing technical expertise in the review, coordination, construction oversight, testing, commissioning, and handover of mechanical infrastructure systems across the project. This position ensures that all mechanical works comply with project specifications, international standards, client requirements, and operational performance objectives. The role requires close coordination with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, consultants, and stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Review and assess mechanical designs, drawings, calculations, specifications, and technical submissions for infrastructure and landscape-related projects. Provide technical oversight of mechanical works during construction to ensure compliance with approved designs, quality standards, and project requirements. Support the delivery of key mechanical infrastructure systems, including pumping stations, irrigation systems, water distribution networks, district cooling interfaces, utility facilities, and associated mechanical assets. Review contractor shop drawings, equipment submittals, method statements, testing procedures, and installation methodologies. Conduct site inspections and monitor mechanical installation activities to ensure compliance with specifications, safety requirements, and project standards. Coordinate with civil, electrical, structural, utilities, landscape, and smart city teams to resolve design and construction interface issues. Participate in technical reviews, constructability assessments, value engineering studies, and multidisciplinary coordination workshops. Support testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, performance verification, and handover activities for mechanical infrastructure systems. Monitor construction progress and provide technical input regarding project schedules, quality performance, risks, and mitigation actions. Assist in identifying and resolving technical challenges, design discrepancies, and construction-related issues. Ensure compliance with local authority requirements, international engineering standards, and project governance procedures. Prepare technical reports, review comments, inspection records, engineering recommendations, and progress updates. Support asset operational readiness initiatives, maintenance considerations, and lifecycle performance objectives. Contribute to the successful achievement of project milestones through proactive technical leadership and stakeholder engagement. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably within large-scale infrastructure or development projects. Demonstrated ability to review and assess complex mechanical designs and technical submissions. Experience with construction oversight, testing, commissioning, and handover processes for mechanical systems. Strong understanding of international engineering standards and project governance procedures. Work Environment This position is a full-time role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working within a multidisciplinary PMCM team. The role involves close collaboration with various project stakeholders, including contractors, consultants, and internal teams. Career Development SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering offers opportunities for professional growth, skill development, and recognition for contributions made within the role.

685d754c349efc69.description: About the Role Dallah Healthcare is seeking an Outpatient Pharmacy Supervisor to oversee the daily operations of its outpatient pharmacy. This full-time role involves ensuring the timely and accurate dispensing of medications, maintaining compliance with safety and regulatory standards, and delivering high-quality service to patients within the outpatient setting. The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Supervise outpatient pharmacy staff, including pharmacists and pharmacy technicians, during daily shifts. Monitor prescription processing to ensure accuracy, patient safety, and timely service delivery. Ensure medication dispensing adheres to applicable laws, hospital policies, and SFDA/MOH regulations. Support inventory control by overseeing stock levels, monitoring expiration dates, and managing reordering processes. Act as a primary contact between the pharmacy and outpatient clinics to resolve medication-related issues. Provide technical guidance to pharmacy staff and ensure adherence to best practices and quality standards. Train new staff members and contribute to the development of standard operating procedures. Handle escalated patient concerns professionally to ensure patient satisfaction. Contribute to audits, quality assurance, and continuous improvement initiatives within the pharmacy. Ensure all work is performed in accordance with approved policies, processes, procedures, and instructions. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in systems, processes, and practices, considering leading practices, cost reduction, and productivity. Follow up on escalated cases and issues from subordinates to ensure efficient and timely resolution. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy. Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in a hospital or outpatient pharmacy setting. Knowledge: Good understanding of pharmacy regulations, medication safety, and outpatient workflows. Regulatory Understanding: Familiarity with the Saudi healthcare system and regulatory compliance. Work Type This is a full-time position within Dallah Healthcare. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

68852e0c57fe84fc.description: As Senior Manager –Utilities Commercialization, Assist the Senior Director in undertaking strategic assessment; undertaking the requisite compilation of business cases including building, maintaining and reviewing robust financial models for utilities and infrastructure projects with a focus on project finance, valuation modelling, scenario analysis; and supporting decision making for commercialization assessments and implementation. Key Responsibilities Develop financial models covering demand, revenues, tariff escalation, CAPEX, OPEX, lifecycle costs, financing, tax, working capital and returns. Build project finance structures including debt sizing, repayment sculpting, debt service reserve accounts, DSCR/LLCR analysis, covenants and shareholder distributions. Prepare valuation models using DCF, NPV, IRR, payback, comparable benchmarks and scenario-based valuation outputs. Run sensitivities and stress tests to assess project robustness, affordability, funding gaps, bankability and downside risk. Maintain model governance standards, including version control, audit trails, change logs, assumptions registers and quality checks. Translate model outputs into clear dashboards, charts, decision papers and presentations for DFA management and senior stakeholders. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics or a related discipline; CFA, CA, MBA or financial modelling certification preferred. Experience: 8+ years of experience in financial modelling, project finance, valuations, infrastructure advisory, investment banking, corporate finance or transaction support. Technical skills: Advanced Excel modelling capability, including clear model architecture, auditability, scenarios, sensitivities and presentation-ready outputs; VBA, Power Query, Power BI or Python experience is advantageous. Finance knowledge: Strong grasp of DCF valuation, project finance debt mechanics, financial statements, accounting basics, return metrics and infrastructure investment analysis. Working style: High attention to detail, strong communication skills, ability to work under deadlines and confidence challenging assumptions with stakeholders. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, Urban Development, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related discipline 8-12 years of relevant experience in real estate, infrastructure development or development finance Advanced Excel and modelling capability Experience in land economics, infrastructure advisory or master development strongly preferred Strong understanding of land development lifecycle, infrastructure delivery, subdivision Understanding of principles of land valuation, cost planning and land use classifications Strong project management and stakeholder management skills Excellent communication skills Ability to synthesize technical and financial inputs Strong problem-solving capability

6891cb54454d40a3.description: About the Role Al Khinji Services is seeking a Planning Engineer to join their team in Umluj. This full-time role requires a well-organized self-starter with strong attention to detail, responsible for managing project schedules, budgets, and resources to ensure timely and cost-effective project completion. Key Responsibilities Develop work schedules and budgets based on project specifications. Delegate tasks effectively to team members. Analyze project specifications to identify cost-effective solutions. Liaise with contractors and suppliers to ensure smooth project execution. Manage resources efficiently to meet project demands. Communicate regularly with surveyors, managers, and other engineers. Monitor and track project progress, preparing detailed reports. Attend and schedule meetings as required for project coordination. Ensure all contract requirements are understood and met. Communicate effectively with managers, supervisors, and the project team. Ensure all projects are completed on time and within allocated budgets. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a planning engineering role. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage project schedules and budgets. Proven track record of ensuring projects are completed on time and within budget. Required Skills Strong organizational skills. Excellent attention to detail. Effective communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to analyze project specifications and find efficient solutions. Resource management capabilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Umluj, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working collaboratively with various stakeholders including contractors, suppliers, surveyors, managers, and other engineers within a project-driven environment. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

68b16adc78243029.description: About Systra SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs safe and sustainable transport solutions globally, aiming to connect people and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing infrastructure and transport systems across the entire project lifecycle, from design to maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA generates 74% of its turnover internationally and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. The Role of Civil Inspector SYSTRA is seeking a Civil Inspector (Saudi National) to join the Project Management Consultant (PMC) team for a metro project in Riyadh. This full-time role involves monitoring and inspecting civil works on site to ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, contract requirements, quality standards, and applicable health and safety regulations. This position is open to all qualified applicants. Key Responsibilities Conduct routine and detailed inspections of civil works at the site. Ensure all works comply with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and relevant codes and standards. Inspect materials delivered to site and verify compliance with approved submittals. Witness site tests and inspections in accordance with the inspection and test plan. Monitor contractor workmanship and construction practices to ensure quality requirements are achieved. Identify non-conforming work and report deficiencies to the Resident Engineer or relevant supervision personnel. Maintain inspection requests, site records, checklists, photographs, and daily reports. Verify that corrective actions are implemented and closed out in a timely manner. Coordinate with QA/QC personnel and other engineering disciplines on interface and compliance matters. Support progress monitoring by reporting actual site status and construction issues. Ensure that health, safety, and environmental requirements are observed during the execution of works. Assist with snagging, de-snagging, substantial completion inspections, and handover processes. Qualifications and Experience Candidates must be a Saudi National. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in civil inspection roles. Demonstrated ability to monitor and inspect civil works effectively. Strong understanding of construction drawings, specifications, and quality standards. Knowledge of applicable health and safety regulations in construction. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for a metro project. The role requires on-site presence to conduct inspections and monitor construction activities.

6860de9eee6901a9.description: About the Role Yamama Cement Company is seeking a Senior Mechanic to join their team. This full-time role involves performing essential mechanical maintenance work to ensure the efficient operation of production units. The Senior Mechanic will be responsible for routine, preventive, and emergency maintenance tasks, adhering to established policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Execute routine, preventive, and emergency mechanical maintenance work in strict adherence to approved policies and procedures. Monitor the performance of production units to ensure operation within designated limits and report any observations that could impact equipment efficiency. Identify necessary tools and equipment for maintenance, assess their readiness, and conduct preventive maintenance to ensure continuous availability. Organize and store maintenance tools in their designated locations, maintain them properly, and ensure the correct disposal of maintenance waste. Perform mechanical repair tasks, including welding, cutting, and refurbishing replaced parts to ensure their readiness and efficiency. Comply with all safety procedures before commencing work, which includes verifying required permits and lockout/tagout forms. Undertake any other tasks as assigned by the direct supervisor. Qualifications and Requirements A Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a related field is required. Work Type This is a full-time position within Yamama Cement Company. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role.

68ebfd24acb06383.description: About Faena The Red Sea Faena The Red Sea is expanding into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, building on a foundation of art, culture, and community. The company focuses on authentic hospitality and transformative experiences, creating spaces through imaginative design and meaningful collaboration. This new venture in Saudi Arabia aims to establish a world of beauty, wonder, and connection. Role Summary The Sales Coordinator (Saudi National Only) at Faena The Red Sea supports the Commercial team with administrative tasks, client coordination, and sales organization during the pre-opening and launch phases. This full-time role, based in Saudi Arabia, ensures efficient operation of the Sales team by managing inquiries, preparing proposals, coordinating client communications, and maintaining accurate systems and reporting. The Sales Coordinator acts as an ambassador for the Faena brand, contributing to revenue generation across transient, leisure, corporate, and group segments. Key Responsibilities Provide daily administrative support to the Sales team to ensure smooth operations. Prepare sales proposals, contracts, presentations, and client correspondence in line with brand standards. Respond to incoming sales inquiries promptly and professionally, routing opportunities to appropriate team members. Coordinate appointments, client meetings, site inspections, familiarization trips, and sales travel schedules. Maintain accurate account profiles, activity logs, leads, and pipeline updates in CRM systems such as Delphi or Salesforce. Track production reports, account performance, and sales activity summaries for leadership review. Assist in preparing monthly reports, budgets, forecasts, and market intelligence updates. Support contract administration, including rate loading requests, agreement follow-up, and documentation filing. Liaise with Reservations and Operations teams to ensure accurate handover of bookings, VIP arrivals, and client requirements. Assist with trade shows, road shows, networking events, and promotional activations. Coordinate the distribution of collateral, fact sheets, presentations, and promotional materials to clients and partners. Ensure all files, databases, and department records remain organized and up to date. Support pre-opening commercial initiatives, including database building, lead generation tracking, and launch readiness tasks. Maintain confidentiality, professionalism, and exceptional service standards in all communications. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 1–3 years of experience in hotel sales coordination, reservations, administration, or commercial support. Previous experience within luxury hospitality or lifestyle brands is preferred. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with polished client-facing etiquette. Detail-oriented with strong follow-up and problem-solving abilities. Positive, proactive, and service-driven attitude. Ability to work in a fast-paced pre-opening environment with agility and professionalism. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with Opera, Delphi, Salesforce, Lanyon / Cvent, or similar hotel systems is preferred. Fluent English and Arabic is mandatory. Working Environment This role involves close collaboration with Sales, Events, Revenue, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams. The position is full-time and requires working in a dynamic pre-opening environment in Saudi Arabia. 6848f53bc673c2ae.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ليدر سيستمز عن محامٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة القضايا وتجهيز ملفاتها، بالإضافة إلى تمثيل الموكلين أمام مختلف درجات المحاكم والجهات الرسمية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاماة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة القضايا وتحليل عناصرها وتحديد الرأي القانوني بشأنها. جمع البينات الخطية والشخصية والأدلة، وتحضير لائحة الدعوى وحافظات المستندات. تسجيل الدعاوى لدى المحكمة المختصة ومتابعة إجراءات التبليغ وحضور الجلسات. المرافعة في القضايا أمام مختلف درجات المحاكم واللجان والمجالس الرسمية حتى صدور الحكم. تمثيل الموكلين (مدعين أو مدعى عليهم) وتقديم المدافعة والإنذارات والاعتراضات والمطالبات. المفاوضة وصياغة العقود والاتفاقيات مع الجهات الرسمية وغير الرسمية وتوثيقها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير القانونية المتخصصة وحفظها وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاماة. معرفة قوية بالإجراءات القانونية والمحاكم السعودية. القدرة على تحليل القضايا وتقديم الاستشارات القانونية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في صياغة العقود والمستندات القانونية. القدرة على المرافعة والمدافعة بفعالية. مهارات تواصل قوية، شفهية وكتابية. القدرة على تنظيم الملفات وحفظ الوثائق بدقة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. يعمل المحامي ضمن فريق قانوني متخصص، ويكون مسؤولاً عن إدارة مجموعة متنوعة من القضايا القانونية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة ليدر سيستمز، يرجى تقديم طلب التوظيف مع السيرة الذاتية.

68522ecee878df37.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اليمامة للأعمال التجارية والمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على جميع جوانب عمليات الصيانة، بما في ذلك التخطيط، وتوزيع المهام، وتقييم الأداء، وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لأعمال الصيانة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتصميم برامج لتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل بكفاءة. مهارات ممتازة في إدارة وتوجيه فرق العمل. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتصميم البرامج المناسبة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية قوية. قدرة عالية على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات. مهارات تواصل فعالة مع فريق العمل والإدارة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والإدارية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل مشرف الصيانة ضمن فريق متخصص، ويكون مسؤولاً عن الإشراف المباشر على عمليات الصيانة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

688abcea373e7031.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة المشروعات الشرقية لأعمال المباني عن مشرف تنظيف وتدبير للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على أنشطة التدبير في المرافق التجارية وتنسيقها وتنفيذها، لضمان الحفاظ على المرافق مرتبة ونظيفة بشكل مستمر. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الجداول الزمنية لخدمات التنظيف والتدبير. تخطيط وإعداد الجداول الزمنية الخاصة بأعمال الموظفين. الإشراف المباشر على الموظفين أثناء أدائهم لواجباتهم، بما في ذلك مسح الأتربة، كنس الأرضيات، تنظيف دورات المياه، وتغيير الشراشف. الحث على تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي المعتمدة. مراقبة مخزون إمدادات التنظيف والمعدات والإمدادات الأخرى، والحفاظ عليه. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الإشراف على التنظيف أو التدبير المنزلي. القدرة على إدارة الجداول الزمنية وتنسيق المهام بفعالية. مهارات إشرافية جيدة لضمان أداء الموظفين وفق المعايير المطلوبة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة حائل، وتتطلب الوظيفة التفرغ الكامل. سيعمل المشرف ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان أعلى مستويات النظافة والترتيب في المرافق التجارية. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة المشروعات الشرقية لأعمال المباني في دور محوري يساهم في الحفاظ على بيئة عمل نظيفة ومنظمة. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

68a8a9e822d5f38f.description: About Delivery Hero SE HungerStation is part of Delivery Hero Group, a global local delivery platform operating in over 70 countries. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is included in the MDAX stock market index. The company's mission is to provide a fast, easy, and reliable delivery experience. Role Summary The Director of Fintech will lead and oversee HungerStation's initiatives to leverage technology for the development and implementation of financial technology solutions. This role is based in Riyadh and focuses on enhancing financial processes, customer transactions, and overall business efficiency. It is a full-time position. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute HungerStation’s financial technology strategy, aligning with business growth, digital transformation, and customer experience objectives. Lead the design and implementation of scalable fintech solutions to support high-volume transactions across customers, merchants, riders, and internal finance operations. Drive innovation in payment systems, digital wallets, refunds, settlements, and reconciliation processes to ensure speed, accuracy, and reliability. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, and Finance teams to integrate fintech solutions into HungerStation’s platform and operational workflows. Ensure compliance with Saudi regulatory requirements (SAMA, ZATCA, VAT, data protection) and Delivery Hero group policies, while managing fintech-related risks and controls. Oversee fraud detection, transaction monitoring, and cybersecurity measures for financial systems and digital payments. Manage the fintech budget, focusing on cost efficiency, ROI optimization, and sustainable investment in new technologies and partnerships. Analyze financial and transaction data to identify trends, revenue opportunities, cost optimization areas, and system performance improvements. Prepare executive-level financial technology reports and dashboards, providing insights on transaction performance, risk exposure, and innovation impact. Lead and develop a high-performing fintech team, fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. Monitor emerging fintech trends (open banking, embedded finance, BNPL, digital wallets, AI-driven fraud prevention) and assess their relevance to HungerStation’s ecosystem. Build and manage strategic relationships with banks, payment providers, fintech startups, and regulatory bodies. Support business expansion initiatives by enabling new financial products and services for merchants and customers. Required Capabilities Contribute to the development and execution of the Division’s ABCs and OKRs, ensuring alignment with other Functions' heads. Make critical decisions that support the Division's strategic and tactical direction. Establish plans for respective functions/teams and provide inputs that support the Division’s goals and objectives. Distribute tactical responsibilities effectively to potential leaders in the Division to improve organizational succession readiness. Measure and track relevant OKRs and metrics to ensure goal achievement and implement corrective actions when necessary. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

68b41124f6287df5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الجريسي لخدمات الكمبيوتر والاتصالات عن فني إطفاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الظهران. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة أنظمة إنذار الحريق والحماية، بالإضافة إلى استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها لضمان الأداء الأمثل لهذه الأنظمة الحيوية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب وبرمجة وتكوين واستكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها وصيانة أنظمة وشبكات إنذار الحريق والحماية. فحص وخدمة وتعديل والتحقق من أنظمة الحماية من الحريق وفقًا للمعايير والقواعد المعتمدة. إجراء الترقيات والإصلاحات والإضافات أو التحسينات على الأنظمة بعد عمليات التفتيش. إعداد تقارير التفتيش الكاملة والدقيقة. الاستجابة لمكالمات الطوارئ خلال المساء وعطلات نهاية الأسبوع على أساس التناوب. العمل تحت إشراف مهندس أنظمة إنذار الحريق والحماية للحفاظ على نظام إنذار الحرائق. إجراء الإصلاحات الميدانية والبحث عن الأعطال واستكشافها حسب الحاجة. تثبيت وبرمجة والتحقق من لوحات إنذار الحريق والأجهزة وأنظمة الإخماد. تركيب أنظمة إنذار حريق معنونة جديدة في الجامعة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة دبلوم لمدة 3 سنوات في الإلكترونيات العامة من كلية أو جامعة مرموقة. خبرة لا تقل عن سنتين في صيانة أنظمة وشبكات إنذار الحريق والحماية. معرفة واسعة بمعايير إنذار الحريق مثل NFPA 70 والتحكم فيها. معرفة كاملة بالعمل مع جميع المعدات النشطة والسلبية المستخدمة في أنظمة وشبكات إنذار الحريق والحماية. إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية. القدرة والرغبة في التواصل بفعالية ومشاركة المعلومات وحل المشكلات والعمل ضمن فريق. الدقة في إعداد تقارير التفتيش. امتلاك رخصة قيادة سعودية سارية المفعول. المهارات الإضافية المعرفة الواسعة بالإصلاحات الميدانية ومهارات تتبع الأخطاء القوية واستكشاف الأعطال تعتبر ميزة إضافية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل الالتزام بالاستجابة للطوارئ خارج ساعات العمل العادية وفقًا لجدول تناوبي. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

68e7c813ba5cc91b.description: About Alfanar Projects Alfanar Projects is seeking an Order Management Specialist to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is essential for ensuring the efficient execution of the order-to-cash process, focusing on order fulfillment and enhancing customer satisfaction through data-driven insights. Role Overview The Order Management Specialist will be responsible for optimizing workflows, improving service delivery, and supporting organizational growth. This involves efficient coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders to manage order fulfillment, process various order types, and leverage customer feedback for continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Manage daily order fulfillment activities to ensure smooth processing and invoicing. Prioritize orders for key partners and address escalations from the sales team promptly. Oversee the processing of sales orders, customer service orders, and gift orders. Coordinate with stores, demand and sales planning, and finance teams to track order performance and ensure timely delivery. Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and improve service delivery. Manage the Central Survey Hub to collect, organize, and analyze customer feedback for actionable insights. Coordinate with the order management team to ensure a seamless and efficient order processing experience. Design and maintain detailed reports for internal teams to monitor performance and progress. Regularly analyze customer insights and operational data to identify trends and drive improvements. Continuously review and refine existing procedures to address gaps and optimize workflows. Follow up on pending documents in ECC, C4C, POD, and other relevant systems. Accountabilities HR Proficiency: Obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job. Delivery: Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules, utilizing resources effectively within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Problem-Solving: Solve related problems and escalate complex operational issues. Quality: Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Business Process Improvements: Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Compliance: Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Health, Safety, and Environment: Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity. The role requires a strong understanding of order-to-cash processes, customer service principles, and data analysis. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring close collaboration with various internal teams and external stakeholders to achieve operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

68fb19a9545008ae.description: تحقيق الأهداف البيعية الالتزام بسياسة العمل المعتمدة من قبل الشركة داخل المعارض عرض المنتجات بطريقة جذابة ومنسقة وفق لطريقة العرض المعتمدة عرض المنتجات للعميل ضمن نطاق القسم المسؤول عنه مراجعة وحفظ الوصف والتصنيف للمنتجات الاطلاع على العروض والبضائع الحديثة المشاركة في أعمال الجرد الدوري والسنوي القيام بمهام محاسب الزبائن وفق حاجة العمل وضع (الباركود) متضمن السعر على جميع البضائع داخل المعرض الالتزام بسلامة المعرض ومحتوياته من أي أخطار قد تضر بالمعرض أو الزملاء التعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى العملاء والعمل على حلها بالتنسيق مع مدير المعرض شرح المنتجات للعملاء مساعدة العميل واستيعاب احتياجه للحصول عما يبحث عنه استقبال العملاء بالتحية والابتسامة شهادة ثانوية تحقيق أهداف المبيعات من خلال التعامل مع العملاء المحتملين على أساس يومي وتقديم الدعم التشغيلي في إغلاق معاملات البيع

68b2ac73fc01cd6a.description: About the Role Tree is seeking a Pricing and Underwriting Associate Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing daily pricing and underwriting activities, conducting comprehensive portfolio performance analysis, and monitoring key financial metrics. The successful candidate will provide actionable insights to support management decisions, ensure pricing adequacy, and improve portfolio profitability. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day pricing and underwriting activities in line with established guidelines and business objectives. Collect, validate, and analyze premiums, claims, and other relevant data to assess portfolio performance and pricing adequacy. Monitor portfolio profitability and recommend pricing and underwriting adjustments as necessary. Assess underwriting risks and ensure alignment with established underwriting guidelines and risk appetite. Support the development, review, and enhancement of pricing models and methodologies. Conduct market analysis and monitor emerging trends, competitive pricing, and changes in market dynamics. Develop detailed loss ratio reports and performance analysis by policy, segment, region, and product. Prepare periodic client performance reports, highlighting key trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. Develop forecasts, analytical reports, and Business Intelligence dashboards to support management decisions. Collaborate with relevant departments to improve pricing accuracy, underwriting practices, and portfolio performance. Oversee daily pricing and underwriting deliverables, ensuring accuracy, quality, and timely completion. Identify opportunities to improve pricing and underwriting processes, systems, and reporting capabilities. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in pricing and underwriting roles. Key Interfaces This role involves regular interaction and collaboration with several internal departments to ensure cohesive operations and strategic alignment. Key interfaces include: Direct Manager Claims Department Actuarial Department Product Department Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to a dynamic team focused on financial performance and risk management.

683f777a03fd03aa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني ميكانيكي معدات زراعية للانضمام إلى فريقها في صفوى، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب وصيانة المعدات الزراعية، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها لضمان استمرارية العمليات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تركيب الأجهزة والمعدات الزراعية والإشراف على إجراءات تشغيلها. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المعدات الزراعية لأغراض الخدمة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص أعطال المعدات الزراعية بدقة ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع المهام. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة وإصلاح المعدات الزراعية. القدرة على فحص وتشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية والكهربائية للمعدات الزراعية. معرفة جيدة بأنواع القطع التبديلية ومواصفاتها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة في مدينة صفوى بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع الأوقات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

6888b8ac2fe78209.description: About the Role Seara International is seeking a Storekeeper to manage the daily operations of receiving, storing, preserving, and issuing temperature-sensitive raw materials. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires strict adherence to cold-chain standards and food safety protocols to ensure continuous production supply. Key Responsibilities Receive incoming frozen raw material shipments, verifying quantities, batch numbers, and product specifications against Purchase Orders (POs) and Delivery Notes. Check and log core product temperatures and refrigerated truck temperatures upon arrival to ensure cold-chain integrity. Inspect packaging for damage, thawing, freezer burn, or contamination, and quarantine or reject non-conforming goods immediately. Organize and store frozen raw materials in designated racking locations within blast freezers and cold rooms, adhering to product categories and allergen segregation rules. Enforce FEFO (First-Expired, First-Out) and FIFO (First-In, First-Out) stock rotation principles to minimize expiration and waste. Ensure clear labeling on all pallets and cartons, including receiving date, batch/lot number, and expiry date. Pick, stage, and issue frozen raw materials to production lines based on approved Material Requisition Forms (MRFs) within scheduled timelines. Coordinate with Production and Quality Assurance (QA) teams regarding material availability, urgent requests, and shelf-life alerts. Monitor and record freezer and cold-room temperatures at scheduled intervals, reporting equipment malfunctions or temperature deviations immediately. Maintain high standards of warehouse hygiene, sanitation, and pest control in compliance with HACCP, GMP, and local food authority regulations. Update stock movements accurately in the ERP/WMS system (*, SAP, Oracle, or Excel trackers) in real time. Conduct daily cycle counts and participate in monthly/annual physical stocktakes, investigating and reconciling inventory variances. Prepare daily stock status, near-expiry, and damage/wastage reports for management review. Performance Indicators The role's effectiveness will be measured against key performance indicators including: Inventory Accuracy: Achieving ≥ ** alignment between physical stock and system records. Shrinkage / Wastage Rate: Maintaining * loss due to expiration, damage, or temperature abuse. Cold-Chain Compliance: Ensuring 100% adherence to receiving temperature checks and daily temperature logs. Order Fulfillment / Issuance Turnaround: Providing on-time material supply to production with zero line stoppages. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in storekeeping or warehouse management, particularly with temperature-sensitive goods. A strong understanding of cold-chain standards, food safety protocols (HACCP/ISO), and inventory management principles (FIFO/FEFO) is required. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic warehouse environment, requiring consistent monitoring of freezer and cold-room temperatures and adherence to strict hygiene and safety regulations. The Storekeeper will work closely with production and quality assurance teams to ensure efficient material flow and compliance.

68b05e952fe40793.job_title: EY Parthenon Strategy Senior Manager Real Estate
68b05e952fe40793.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Strategy - Real Estate to join its team. This full-time role focuses on the residential business unit, contributing to the development of an efficient portfolio with products tailored to evolving target demographics across various masterplans. 68ba0af940c6f164.description: The Warehouse Chemist is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and efficient management of chemicals and dangerous goods within warehouse operations.
